description: We’re a two-person team building CrewPulse, a React Native prototype to help astronauts log daily health checks and track changes in heart rate and balance during long missions. I’m Md Hasan Zaker, a software engineering master’s student at Memorial University with full-stack development experience. We welcome teammates with skills in mobile development, UI/UX design, data visualization, or health sciences to help us build and test the app.
